name: android-studio
description: Android development from Kimi Code: drive emulators and devices (boot, install, launch, screenshots, UI hierarchy, taps, swipes, logcat), run gradle builds and tests, and — with the bundled JetBrains MCP Server plugin enabled — control Android Studio itself over MCP.
author: mnshkv

interface.shortDescription: Emulators, devices, adb, gradle builds — and Android Studio IDE tools over MCP
interface.longDescription:
Two layers of Android integration for Kimi Code:

1. android-tools MCP server (bundled, stdio, zero dependencies): 19 tools over adb/emulator/gradle — list devices and AVDs, boot emulators and wait for them, install/launch/uninstall APKs, take screenshots, dump the UI hierarchy (uiautomator) to find element bounds, synthesize taps/swipes/text/key events, read logcat, run device shell commands, and run gradle tasks (build, test, assembleDebug, ...) through the project's gradlew.

2. Optional Android Studio IDE tools: install the official JetBrains MCP Server plugin into Android Studio (scripts/install-jetbrains-mcp-plugin.sh) and enable the MCP server in Settings → Tools → MCP Server; then add http://127.0.0.1:63342 as an MCP server in Kimi Code to get editor file access, run configurations, and other IDE tools.

Prerequisites: Android SDK with platform-tools (adb). For IDE tools: Android Studio 2025.2+.
